t: This is St George in the East, an Anglican church on Cannon Street Road, between The Highway and Cable Street. Behind it lies St George's Gardens, which was the church's original graveyard. The church was designed by Nicholas Hawksmoor, a leading figure of English Baroque. He worked alongside Christopher Wren and John Vanbrugh, and contributed to St Paul's Cathedral, Greenwich Hospital, Blenheim Palace and Castle Howard. Here in the East End you are looking at his own design.
